title: Provenance
description: Who or what authored a value, embedded on every config-model entity. This is what makes every table AI-ready from scratch: a value is either HUMAN-authored, AI_SUGGESTED (via natural-language instruction, pending or after human approval), AI_DERIVED (e.g. a BI-history-based proposal), or IMPORTED (e.g. from an ERP migration). AI-sourced values always carry a model, a confidence, and a rationale — never a silent number.

authoredBy.description: User id, or an AI actor id such as "ai:claude-sonnet-5"

approvedBy.description: Required before an AI_SUGGESTED value may go ACTIVE — see design principle: AI suggests, never silently applies.
